flags.title: Size it — don't fall in love
flags.note: Even a clean BUY deserves a position cap and an exit plan. Concentrated conviction (loyalty to one name) is how good theses become big drawdowns.
flags.lesson: Amazon: a great company held with no diversification became the biggest single loss.

threats.point: The nature of the company's business is capital intensive, where any cycle delay causes huge interest loss and impacts the bottom line.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "The Company’s nature of business is capital intensive and hence any delay in cycle causes huge interest loss and marks the bottom line of the Company." (annual report)

threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "The threat is also from unorganized small scale entrepreneurs who sometimes run away with big orders due to their small set up cost." (annual report)

threats.point: Historically weak quarters (Jun, Dec) are still in the cycle.
